source_profile: original C implementation and frozen drivers; legacy CN annotations adapted for locked integer-domain runtime

compatibility.scope: Concrete finite tests under migrated legacy CN syntax and locked runtime. No new trusted functions or bounded predicate unfoldings.
compatibility.driver: Frozen main creates the plan input, calls the target and exits. Checks are inserted into the target pre/post and enabled inline annotations. Driver has no independent result oracle.
compatibility.integers: C-derived 32-bit values represented as CN integers. Width-sensitive length and unsigned accumulator addition use modulo 2^32, signed decrement and unsigned casts retain their 32-bit boundary values. No universal equivalence claim.
compatibility.declarations: Order IntQueueAux, IntQueueFB, IntQueuePtr by dependency; mark IntQueueAux recursive. Original assert_not_equal lemma remains conditional.
